scenePrompt: Create one wide 16:9 landscape image, with no border or typography. A young adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair blowing gently to the left and expressive brown eyes wears a rust-red hooded coat and a black backpack. She holds an unfolded paper map in both hands at chest level, with the entire map visible near the lower edge. Frame her from the waist up in a medium close-up, slightly left of center: her head, torso, and map should fill most of the left half of the image. Her body is turned three-quarters to the right, and she looks up toward the right with a curious, slightly uncertain expression. She stands on a sunlit outdoor commuter-train platform. A long white commuter train with a muted teal stripe remains clearly visible across the right half of the background. The platform canopy and columns recede diagonally from the upper left; a few indistinct commuters stand far behind her. Keep the woman, map, platform, and train all clearly visible.
